Changing this updates the practice account\'s cash right away; your practice trades stay.
Sources, in order: EODHD (licensed), then PSE Edge and the phisix community feed, then data saved on this phone. The app syncs automatically every weekday evening.

On: stock analyses and disclosure summaries are written by Claude Haiku, and the daily market brief by Claude Opus. Only the computed technical indicators are sent; your portfolio and trades never leave this phone. Off, or when AI is unavailable, the built-in rules engine writes the analysis instead.
Pattern names and indicator terms (RSI, MACD, support) stay in English, as they\'re used on every trading platform.
Asks for your fingerprint, face or screen-lock PIN when you open the app, and again after a minute away. Your data is also stored encrypted on the phone.
Anonymous technical details when the app crashes (device model, Android version, the error). No portfolio or personal data.
Most traders risk 0.5% to 2% per trade. Used for the trade plan on each stock.
Defaults: 0.25% commission (₱20 minimum) + 12% VAT, 0.005% PSE fee, 0.01% SCCP fee, 0.1% transaction tax on sells. Check your broker\'s schedule.

Market data may be delayed or contain errors. Always do your own research and consider consulting a licensed professional.
Charts by TradingView Lightweight Charts (Apache 2.0). Disclosures from PSE Edge. AI by Anthropic Claude.
